page_title: RapidAPI for Mac – The most advanced API tool for Mac

summary.name: RapidAPI for Mac (formerly Paw)
summary.one_liner: RapidAPI for Mac is a native macOS HTTP client for composing, testing, and describing APIs.
use_cases: testing your own APIs during development
documenting an API while testing it
sharing API test configurations with a team
summary.what_it_does: RapidAPI for Mac is a full-featured HTTP client with a visual editor for composing all kinds of HTTP requests. It lets you inspect server responses and test APIs you build or consume. It natively supports JSON Schema and is stated to be compliant with Swagger and RAML API descriptions, so you can describe an API while testing it. The page also says it can generate client code and export API definitions. A teamwork feature synchronizes API test configurations and provides real-time updates with conflict-free changes.
notable: Native macOS interface with visual request editor
Native JSON Schema support with Swagger and RAML compliance
Team sync of API test configurations with real-time updates
Generates client code and exports API definitions
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Only macOS is named as a platform
